name: Tanaris
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle changed in places: Sandmoon Village (Sandfury trolls who left Zul'Farrak) and the raised south-east tip of the Shimmering Flats, Noonshade Ruins, Steamwheedle Port (a new house), the Slickwick Oil Rig (goblin town on new coast in the south-west, Land's End reshaped). The 3.3.5 zone, its NPCs and quests stay.
_merge_region: own=changed: only the Tanaris chunks Turtle reshaped or gave a new subzone. reshaped_take_areas: the south-east tip of the Shimmering Flats (439), raised by up to 85 yd as the north end of Turtle's Sandmoon Village (left out of Thousand Needles for this zone). reshaped_skip_zones: Thousand Needles (already merged), Un'Goro Crater, Silithus.
_exclude_creatures: Turtle's own Caverns of Time hub (Chromie, Kheyna Spinpistol, the bronze dragonflight NPCs, Dronormu, Tyvadrius, the inn, the Sunnyglade Valley battlemaster Alurzion): it stands where 3.3.5 has its own Caverns of Time hub (Max's rule: 3.3.5 stays). Turtle systems: the rented mounts (rented_mount) and the Riding Gryphon (npc_flying_mount, free-flight rental). The Uldum Pedestal Target Bunny (Turtle's Uldum gate event, boss Ostarius: C++ only). Fanzy Sparkspring and Gonzo Snaphands (Turtle's Jewelcrafting trainer and supplier). Elodia (ends only 'Shellcoins', Turtle's Shellcoin system; the quest has no giver). The Conquistadores camp on the south-west beach (Xoro III, Recluta, Baltocris) and its objects (exclude_gameobject_boxes): Turtle later raised that beach for the Slickwick Oil Rig and left the camp 2-9 yd under its own new ground.
_exclude_gameobjects: The Caverns of Time placeholder portal and meeting stone, the Caverns of Time race checkpoint (go_race_checkpoint), Speedy's Jukebox (go_radio), the Gardening Zone Check (Turtle's gardening system). Gemstone Deposit (Turtle Jewelcrafting gem node; shares spawn pools with 3.3.5 Thorium/Truesilver veins), as in Badlands, Feralas and Felwood.
_exclude_quests: Turtle's Uldum gate (Gate Keeper / Guardian of the Gate: boss Ostarius, C++ only), The Bronze Betrayal (Tyvadrius, Caverns of Time hub), Return to Kheyna (ends at Kheyna Spinpistol in that hub), a deprecated letter quest. Fanzy Sparkspring's Jewelcrafting quests (41307-41319). Reas's 'A Letter From a Friend' / 'A Slaughter for Brains' (Kheyna's wormhole and the Caverns of Time hub, C++). 'Shellcoins' (no giver; Turtle's Shellcoin system). 'A Letter From Gadgetzan' (its giver is not in the build). 'Rise of the Venture Co.' (ends at Nert Blastentom in Turtle's Sparkwater Port, Durotar, not ported).
_extra_quests: Oglethorbe's Scientific Hunger (Oglethorbe Obnoticus, Booty Bay; filed under Booty Bay): it gives the Finished Cooker Prototype that Dirge Quikcleave's 'Don't tell the Others' asks for.
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credit dummies the manual script gives: Vol'jin's talk (Sandfury Redemption III), the two VIP invitations (Gazlowe, Baron Revilgaz), the shooed shark.
_force_display: Johnny Deepdrowned and Alvida (East Oceanic Trading Co): Turtle's ghost pirate crewman model -> 3.3.5's ghostly pirate crewman (display 1214).
_exclude_gameobject_boxes: The buried Conquistadores camp (see _exclude_creatures): its boat, fish racks, kegs, cannon, torches, bedrolls and floating debris.
